scripts.build: cp index.source.html index.html && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && cp dist/server.cjs dist/server.js && mkdir -p dist/tmp && touch dist/tmp/restart.txt && cp public/.htaccess dist/.htaccess 2>/dev/null || true && cp public/.htaccess ./.htaccess 2>/dev/null || true && cp dist/index.html ./index.html && mkdir -p assets && cp -r dist/assets/* assets/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=fs.readdirSync('dist/assets'); const js=files.find(f=>f.startsWith('app-')&&f.endsWith('.js')); const css=files.find(f=>f.startsWith('index-')&&f.endsWith('.css')); if(js) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/'+js, 'assets/index.js'); if(css) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/'+css, 'assets/index.css'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/version.json', JSON.stringify({commitSha: process.env.GITHUB_SHA || 'local-build', buildTime: process.env.BUILD_TIME || new Date().toISOString()}, null, 2));"
